process_rules: Match fiscal period, business perimeter, GAAP/adjusted basis, tax and share conventions before claiming a beat.
Separate free cash, required liquidity, customer advances, unpaid liabilities, dividends and illiquid investments.
Do not subtract convertible debt and also count every conversion share. Keep deal proceeds and disposed earnings consistent.
Pass-through funds, acquisitions and inflation do not automatically create incremental owner profit.
Use after-SBC EBIT or subtract SBC in historical CFO diagnostics—do not double deduct in the forward model.
Long-term DCF and two-year resale payoff require different evidence. A good exit scenario is not proof of undervaluation.
Use cost ceilings and reverse valuation when unit data are unavailable; do not manufacture churn or ROIC.
Uncalibrated scenarios are not probability bands. Show terminal-value and reinvestment sensitivity.
Preserve dates, vendor differences and old assumptions. Before action, re-roll quotes, claims, fiscal cash flows and transaction terms.
caveat: No buy gate passed. Economic years not precise fiscal stubs; quarter-end balances not a full September roll-forward. Scenarios uncalibrated.
